avgBrandAgeYoyMax.description: Maximum average brand age (360 days statistics)

clickConversionRateT7Max.description: Maximum click conversion rate (7-day statistics), the value range is 0-1, 0.1 represents a conversion rate of 10%

clickCountT7Min.description: Click volume (7 days statistics) minimum value

searchVolumeT7Min.description: Search volume (7 days statistics) minimum value
